23:auth.reason: Besides OAuth 2.0, Zoho Cliq lets each user generate static Webhook Tokens. These are passed as a zapikey query parameter on its api/v2 endpoints so third-party apps can post to channels and bots. That counts as a static key/token, which A missed.

51:access.reason: Any registered user gets working credentials free, plus a free Sandbox for API testing. The $1 credit has no stated time limit, so it is free credit, not a time-limited trial. The $50 top-up is the cost of production usage, not the gate to getting credentials.
